criteria.text: Identifies Automobile Q4 as the anomaly or outlier in the data.
Notes that Automobile Q4 fell about 30% while every other sector grew in Q4.
Recommends investigating the cause of the Automobile Q4 drop before drawing conclusions.
Identifies a sector or quarter other than Automobile Q4 as the main anomaly.
Concludes that the overall business is in decline based on this single quarterly drop.
